row.title: Canary kernel pin moves by a tenant PR
row.body: kernellock --open-pr opens a kernel.lock PR in the canary tenant repo for the current seed tree. The platform row moves only after the tenant main holds that pin, so the other tenants follow a merged canary, never an open one. tenant-sync.yml runs it daily with LANE_PAT.
